finding.name: durable provider intent must cover every deliberate planner step without allowing any implicit retry/failover
finding.reason: The current planner legitimately performs an explicit correction turn on the same Notion thread when the first answer is malformed or refuses the tool protocol. Treating Stage B as literally one provider call per successful request would silently remove this existing behavior. The safety invariant is instead: after strict provider-intent publication, every explicit provider step is attempted at most once, on the already selected lease/account, with AccountLease failover disabled and the server outer transport recursion disabled. A transport failure on any step leaves the durable intent unresolved and publishes no client result. A hard crash between explicit steps is fail-closed on retry.

cases: pool unavailable before intent -> no intent, provider_calls=0
initial bad-tool -> explicit correction good-tool -> same account, no failover, durable replay published
exact retry after durable finalize -> no new provider call
transport failure during correction -> unresolved intent remains, no replay payload, no failover
demonstration: allow_failover=true on correction can switch to a sibling account and create an implicit extra provider attempt
final durable write failure -> unresolved intent remains and no replay payload is published

required_server_rule: acquire local lease before intent; pool/cooldown failure must not create intent
pass allow_failover=false to the initial/continuation lease.run
pass allow_failover=false to every planner-correction lease.run under the same intent
suppress the outer foreground transport recursion after intent
on any ambiguous transport failure leave the intent unresolved and return fail-closed
only after a valid final completion build one canonical Responses payload and strictly finalize it
only after finalize publish memory affinity/reservation and client JSON/SSE
